visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short hair and a white fuzzy headband, wearing dark blue silk pajamas, stands in a brightly lit indoor bedroom. She holds a large blue box featuring a sleek white guitar design with the text 'LAVA GENIE.' The background includes a window with blinds and a minimalist room setup. (2) The woman pulls out a white, minimalist electronic guitar-like instrument from the box. She enthusiastically handles the device, showing its smooth texture and light-up buttons. She then attaches a white strap to the instrument, preparing to play it. (3) The frame transitions to a digital screen capture of an app interface. It displays various song selections and sound presets with colorful thumbnails. Text overlays indicate different versions and features of the smart guitar software, such as '2.0 version' and 'AI accompaniment.' (4) Sitting on the edge of her bed, the woman holds the white LAVA GENIE guitar. She gestures with her hands while explaining the features of the instrument. The lighting is soft and warm, highlighting her expressive facial movements and the modern design of the room. (5) A performance scene begins with a screen overlay showing chords and lyrics. The woman 'plays' the instrument by pressing buttons on its neck while singing. Animated hearts and variety-show style text appear on screen to emphasize the mood. Her expressions are focused yet joyful. (6) The woman continues her demonstration, now shown in a four-way split-screen view. In each quadrant, she mimics a rhythmic playing motion, accompanied by sparkling visual effects. This montage highlights the 'band-in-one' capability of the instrument in a playful, energetic manner. (7) Returning to a single shot, the woman talks about the instrument's suitability for beginners and children. A circular inset photo of a young boy appears briefly. She concludes by pointing toward the camera, inviting viewers to leave comments and engage with her content.

It aims to demonstrate the ease of use for beginners and the advanced 'AI band' features of the app integration, while showcasing a live performance to prove the product's musical capability.
